text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer devised a plan to gradually 
improve Tamamo Cross's small appetite.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, having the culinary-gifted 
Umamusume cook delicious food—failure. Her 
stomach is too small, so no matter how 
good it tastes, she just can't eat it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, seeing her classmate Gold City 
eating properly as part of her job to 
handle both racing and modeling...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross had a change of heart. She 
resolved to keep eating, little by little, 
no matter what.
